DesktopPet.​TNextAnimation
public struct
DesktopPet.​TNextAnimation

Information about next animation

On each animation sequence, there are 3 different NEXT: 1- end of sequence 2- gravity detected 3- border detected If all frames where played, Next-"end of sequence" will be executed.  If Next-"gravity" is set, pet will fall if no gravity is detected.  If a border is detected, Next-"border" will be executed.  Note: if sequence is over or border was detected but you don't have a next statement for it, pet will re-spawn!
